title: A stored fret that lies is flagged, and the derived fret renders
description: One whole note sounding C3 annotated string 5 fret 5 — but string 5 (open A2) sounds C3 at fret 3. The stored fret is non-authoritative: the tab staff draws the DERIVED fret 3, and a red badge reports the disagreement. This is the stored fret's entire v5 job — a mismatch is one of the few signals that catches a broken importer — and the conflict rule of spec-instrument-position.md adjudicated: pitch wins, annotations are checked against it.
